changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO finances.currency_rates (user_id, currency_code, rate, is_base) SELECT u.id, v.currency_code, v.rate, v.is_base FROM system.users u CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('BRL', 1::numeric, true), ('USD', 5.42::numeric, false) ) AS v(currency_code, rate, is_base) WHERE u.email = 'admin@admin.com';
